mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park with a waxing crescent moon. The ISS will be visible tonight starting at 9:13 PM, rising over Verona High School and traveling toward Madison for 3 minutes. The overnight low will hit 58 degrees with no rain predicted.
The Verona Police Department released a summary of notable calls from August 31 through September 14, covering everything from traffic incidents to more serious burglary investigations.

There is plenty to do this week, starting with Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee today. Tomorrow, you can look forward to yoga at Insight Wellness, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, and trivia nights at Paddy Mac's and The Bogey Factory.
Looking at the reports for the past two weeks, on September 3, a 33-year-old Madison man was arrested for an O W I second offence after a crash on Shooting Star Road.
The Culver's of Verona is currently open until 10:00 PM tonight, but please note that they are closing soon, so be sure to head over before they shut down for the evening.
